structures.description: A single documented incident told in order: what they did, what happened, what everyone learned. The default and the strongest.
Open on a result that seems impossible, then take the machine apart until the viewer sees why it was inevitable.
4-5 examples, each more surprising than the last, all advancing ONE running idea stated in the first 20 seconds and paid off at the end. Never a catalogue.
Follow the specific person who established what everyone now takes for granted, including what it cost them.
A rule exists because something went wrong. Show the rule, then show the thing that created it.
